name: ITER Organization
role: Builds the ITER tokamak at Cadarache. The divertor uses about 300,000 tungsten monoblocks [S08], and in 2023 ITER switched the first-wall armour from beryllium to tungsten [S07].
evidence: Sayari shows no inbound tungsten shipment under HS 2611, 8101, 2841 or 2849 [X01]. Its one tungsten record is outbound: HS 810199 to NIIEFA, a Rosatom-owned institute on Ukraine's sanctions list, on 2023-03-17 [X01, X16].

name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
role: Builds the SPARC tokamak in Devens, Massachusetts, using REBCO high-temperature superconducting magnets [S12].
evidence: Sayari shows no inbound tungsten shipment, with or without an HS filter [X02]. One outbound HS 810199 record goes to OOO S-Innovatsii (Russia), dated 2022-05-04 [X02]. Its tungsten suppliers are not visible in public trade data.

name: A.L.M.T. Corp. (Sumitomo Electric)
role: Certified supplier of tungsten for ITER's divertor outer vertical targets [S09]. Listed as an RMAP-conformant tungsten smelter in SEC conflict-minerals filings [S33].
evidence: Supplier role confirmed by Sumitomo Electric [S09]. Not traced in Sayari.

name: Vacuum Techniques Pvt Ltd
role: Trading intermediary on the shortest Sayari path between Plansee and ITER.
evidence: Graph edge only. The products on both trade edges are unconfirmed [X15].

name: Plansee SE
role: Refractory-metal manufacturer in Reutte. It produced ITER divertor mock-ups for high-heat-flux qualification [S47].
evidence: Sayari watchlist finds sanctioned Russian buyers one hop away (Krasnoyarsk Non-Ferrous Metals Plant; TD Proton-Electrotex, OFAC SDN) [X03]. Its forced-labor flags are derived from network analysis of its supply chain, not from a finding against Plansee [X03].

name: Plansee India HPM
role: Plansee group affiliate. A large importer of tungsten products (HS 8101).
evidence: 4,459 HS 8101 import rows, the latest dated 2026-02-27 [X04].

name: Xiamen Honglu Tungsten-Molybdenum
role: Tungsten wire and products maker; a subsidiary of Xiamen Tungsten.
evidence: Shipped HS 810196 tungsten wire to Plansee India, 2026-01-28 to 2026-02-05 [X05]. This is the strongest direct tungsten link into the Plansee group.

name: Xiamen Tungsten Co.
role: One of China's largest integrated tungsten groups, covering mining, APT, powder and wire.
evidence: Shareholder of Xiamen Honglu (ownership edge) [X06]. Its exports have needed licences since China's February 2025 controls [S25].

name: H.C. Starck Tungsten GmbH
role: Tungsten powder and APT processor in Goslar.
evidence: Bought HS 2841 tungstates from Vietnam: 232 rows to 2024-11-08 [X07]. Owners recorded in Sayari are Mitsubishi Materials and Masan Tungsten [X07].

name: Global Tungsten & Powders
role: Tungsten processor in Towanda, Pennsylvania. RMI smelter ID CID000568 [S33].
evidence: Received more than 320 t of concentrate from Rwanda's Nyakabingo mine [S20].

name: China Tungsten High-Tech
role: State-owned tungsten carbide and products group.
evidence: No Sayari link to Plansee, ITER or CFS was found [X12].

name: Jiangxi Tungsten Holding
role: Core state-owned enterprise in Jiangxi, China's main tungsten province.
evidence: No link to the fusion anchors was found [X13].

name: Masan Tungsten
role: Processes concentrate into APT and oxides at Nui Phao. Part of Masan High-Tech Materials.
evidence: Buys HS 2611 concentrate from Rwanda (56 rows to 2025-02-07) and from Nui Phao in Vietnam [X08].

name: Traxys Europe S.A.
role: Commodity trader. The top buyer of Rwandan tungsten concentrate.
evidence: 191 rows of Rwandan HS 2611 imports to 2026-07-30. Also ships to sanctioned RUSAL Krasnoyarsk and Uralredmet [X09].

name: Karenni and Shan tungsten districts
role: Tin-tungsten mining in areas held by ethnic armed groups and resistance forces.
evidence: Shipments to China rose 97% year on year to 6,191 t in January–July 2026, and airstrikes killed civilians in the mining district [S22]. Sayari shows only 3 Myanmar HS 2611 shippers [X19].

name: Nui Phao Mining
role: Large tungsten mine outside China, owned by Masan.
evidence: Exported HS 2611 (14 rows, latest 2025-09-06) [X10]. Vietnam mined 3,000 t of tungsten in 2025 [S01].

name: Trinity Nyakabingo Mine
role: Industrial tungsten mine near Kigali. It supplies up to 20% of US primary tungsten concentrate [S20].
evidence: Rwanda's top HS 2611 exporter in Sayari (109 rows) [X11]. No allegation that this mine is contaminated was found. The risk is that it sits in a corridor where the UN documents laundering of Congolese 3T minerals [S17, S19].

name: Artisanal 3T sites, North and South Kivu
role: Artisanal wolframite, cassiterite and coltan mining in eastern DRC.
evidence: The US DOL lists DRC tungsten as made with forced and child labor [S15, S14]. The UN documents M23 control of mining routes and smuggling into Rwanda [S17].

name: Almonty Korea Tungsten (Sangdong)
role: New mine outside China, owned by Almonty Industries (Canada).
evidence: Holds CAGE and SAM US federal contractor IDs [X14]. Almonty Industries has no sanctioned or PEP link within two hops [X18]. No trade link to the fusion anchors was found.
